caption: A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright.
positive_analysis:
1. Wheel contacts curb, causing torque shift; rider leans inward to counterbalance rotational force.  
2. Rider’s center of mass must remain above wheel’s contact point to prevent tipping.  
3. Tire’s grip on ground enables rider to adjust stance without slipping during transition.  
4. Rider’s body weight distribution shifts dynamically to maintain equilibrium over uneven surface.
